title: Q4 Development Overview
html:
Q4 so far

Since October 1 we merged more than 1,150 changes across four repositories: dehubweb (about 650 commits), dehub-mobile (about 520), dehub-stream-backend (27) and stream-admin-hub. This page groups every distinct piece of that work by what it changed for you, with the pull request next to each entry, and grows as the quarter goes on.

The video editor became a studio

The browser editor from Q3 is now a full production tool on web and in the app:

  • Projects save to the cloud with version history (d745ec08bf, f7381fff80), merge saves from several of your devices (#2396, mobile #1765), keep conflicting edits instead of dropping them (#2380, #2381), and can be searched with a recoverable Trash (#2367).
  • Share a cut for review: reviewers leave timestamped comments (#2370, mobile #1738), accepted editors can save the shared project (00f99b6174), anyone invited can decline or leave (#2371), and an optional live session shows who else is editing (#2386) with your unfinished edits protected while others' changes arrive (#2415, #2420, #2421, #2422, #2424, #2426).
  • The editor finds the good parts for you: speech highlights you can review (afafe7ead4), highlights that respect the topics you ask for (#2324), optional visual highlights read from the frames (#2372, #2375), and refinements by chat (#2330, #2337).
  • Cutting got smarter with scene-change detection (9d5b962301), music beat markers with automatic cut alignment (58a14d15d0), numeric cuts you can rely on (#2295), precise frame controls (#2399, mobile #1768) and timed starter templates (#2400, #2537).
  • Assemble a video from media you already have, by describing it or by file name (#2346, #2351), with picture-in-picture layers kept intact (#2453) and chosen scenes matched to the prompt (1ee9ebfbad).
  • Background removal saves against the source timing (#2325) and handles long clips in pages (#2392).
  • Sound: normalise volume and clean up voices (#2303, #2388), keep original fades through cuts (#2326), create soundtrack drafts (#2507) and sound effects (#2510), and import Wikimedia audio (#2509).
  • Captions: import and save subtitle files (9b4d89a5c1), fit captions inside the frame (#2323), wrap and fit any text (#2369), review captions with one-step corrections (4d3e121bc7), and translate whole caption tracks with progress and Undo (34d61b36e3).
  • Record straight into the timeline (5de751c394), record your screen with shared sound and an optional voiceover (d653e9fc62), and on Android record the device screen into the editor (mobile de15c03559).
  • Export every design page (#2345), download animations as looping GIFs (#2307), download cuts as separate files (9f034e5d33), share finished exports through the device picker (#2543), and export animated designs as video by default (#2542).
  • Generation now happens in a docked editor window that stays open while you work (#2637, mobile #2007), and saved media libraries connect to the editor (#2567).

Creator and Maboroshi

  • Dozens of new models arrived, including FLUX video (#2211) and 26 more fal models with validated inputs (#2336, mobile #1713).
  • Presets went from a handful to hundreds: 100 image and video presets (91fb1110a8), every published studio preset with search (#2193), 180 Maboroshi presets (#2629), playable viral video effects (#2633, mobile #2004), playable trend videos (#2662) and a real motion clip library (ca4b719f14).
  • Maboroshi moved into Creator (3ef7d85111, mobile #1799) with video replacement, Creator payment options (#2472), clearer clip and character editing (#2475) and a lower-cost Kling rendering option (#2686).
  • Character workflows and reusable asset references keep a face consistent across generations (65a971b615), and 3D generations show real thumbnails (7909cf22ee).
  • The Creator page got a new hero with a calm video background and a before-and-after intro (#2732, #2733, #2734).

AI agents and tasks

  • Agents take private prompts, bulk actions and scheduled tasks (0ef9f0a77b), daily selective tasks such as posting and liking (0e6dd84a7a), and coordinate in task swarms (#2634, mobile #2005).
  • How many agents and tasks you can run follows your badge (ec24e3f40e).
  • Scheduled agent posts are spaced out with varied content (#2695), stay inside your account limit (#2687), carry thumbnails on video (#2697), publish without minting (#2680) and keep running while posting waits for gas (#2672).
  • Managed profiles can be edited privately and opened from your account cards (4fc074bf9b, #2584).

Feed, video and photos

  • Phone feed videos play as clean muted previews, hug the video's own shape and open in the Shorts viewer, which carries on into the latest shorts (#2646, #2651, mobile #2012). Phone photos and videos cap at 55% of the screen (#2652).
  • On desktop, feed videos hug their shape too, capped at 75% of the screen, with controls only on hover (#2655).
  • Only photos with a song open in Shorts; plain photos open their post, and tall photos fill the Shorts screen (#2722, mobile #2066).
  • Photo posts can carry a soundtrack: a glass capsule that opens into a wave along the photo, playable from the feed and draggable to seek (#2164, #2169, mobile #1547).
  • A Shorts carousel follows the first home post and returns further down, without repeating creators (#2595, #2564, #2679).
  • Scrolling got steadier: no more videos flashing to their poster (#2639), frames locked before they scroll into view (#2671), distant cards windowed out (#2648) and photos and videos that keep their size (#2664).
  • Videos that keep getting paused offer an autoplay switch (bcf88d28d7), foreign-language videos dub themselves with the original audio lowered (#2299), and dubbing is now opt-in with a one-time tip (3328559511).
  • Images keep loading straight from storage when the image service is unreachable (#2721, mobile #2061).

Posting and conversation

  • Schedule a stage or a livestream from the post composer (#2290, mobile #1669).
  • Quote posts use the standard composer (3c43c8a054) and show attached polls (5efa4ae016).
  • Ended polls show final results with the winner ticked (#2402, mobile #1771), and superadmins can set custom vote counts (backend #507, admin #45).
  • The thumbs-down moved into the reaction tray with totals under each emoji (#2104).
  • The post AI button became "AI overview" in the three-dot menu (#2462, mobile #1829), and the comment box has an AI button beside the mic (#2730, mobile #2070).
  • Tapping blank space beside a post's name opens the post; the avatar, name and handle open the profile (#2593, mobile #1970).
  • Unfinished comments and chat drafts are kept, guests included (#2405, #2416).
  • Posting chain selection moved into Settings (#2362).

Sharing

  • Rich cards for Polymarket and Manifold predictions (409d6387f6), Snapshot, Audius, DeFi and any open link (#2360), with source tiles and compact fallbacks (#2491).
  • Share images show text posts and engagement (b9e93ba102) inside a new chrome frame (#2444, #2447, #2450).
  • Bounties share as rich post cards (b80a1c5244).

Live and stages

  • The phone live viewer has a Who's here sheet with top tippers and the most active viewers (#2519, mobile #1892, backend #514), tap or swipe to clear the screen with a rotate button (#2530), and each viewer's arrival shows once in chat (mobile #2062).
  • Live reactions and viewer peaks stay in sync (#2452, backend #512), and live timelines can be shared and recovered (#2430, mobile #1796).
  • People who are live wear a broadcast ripple around their avatar across feeds, profiles, chats and the side panel (#2727, mobile #2069), and the side panel Live tab plays the streams (#2725).
  • Live chat shows a glowing online count (44fd7f817e, mobile #1943) and the chat box stays above the keyboard (#2484, mobile #2064).
  • Live feed tiles open the live page on any tap (mobile #1886).
  • Stage speech runs on Chirp voices and video dubs on Chatterbox (030859ead7, mobile #1725).

Profiles and communities

  • Profiles got a frosted collapsing header (85024a9c63), one themed glass navigation row (#2549), and desktop profiles wear their pinned community's art (#2418).
  • Owners choose which tab their profile opens on (mobile #2072), can edit their username (#2610, mobile #1984), and every tab shows real totals (#2735, backend #521).
  • Subscription plans can be pinned to profiles (backend #497, mobile #1555).
  • Invite your followers to a community with confirmed delivery (#2473), add existing posts without copying engagement (#2469), and see recent contributors recognised (#2165, backend #496).

Messages

  • Sent messages clear from every box straight away (#2484, #2486) and replies stay until the server confirms them (52ea436328).
  • Public chat opens instantly and shows unread chips (d16c73a465, mobile #1628), and unread markers behave after reopening a conversation (#2358).
  • Encryption setup reconnects your wallet before turning on (9f1312244b), and translated DMs no longer crash the app (mobile #2057).
  • Calls no longer stutter (#2147).

Themes and design

  • System Light is a new theme on web and in the app (#2612, mobile #1994), with readable toasts, drawers and standalone pages (#2647, #2654, #2657, mobile #2016).
  • The System theme went fully immersive with no boxes (#2261, mobile #1631).
  • The theme picker shows Minimal and Minimal Light (#2534).
  • The DeHub Cut icon family now covers every control (cfd741c871, #2574, #2592).
  • Every desktop tooltip is liquid glass (#2723), unread chips are solid in every theme (#2597), and Island's lagoon got reflective water (#2554).
  • A shared page kit put every remaining page on the home look (#2186, mobile #1568).

Wallets, payments and economy

  • Wallet login and recovery use single-use proofs (#2551, backend #517, backend #518), and wallet encryption costs are bounded (#2544).
  • Saved phone passkeys unlock on other browsers (8363ec0509), interrupted wallet resets resume (#2681), Import Wallet opens directly (#2678), and inaccessible wallets can be replaced while keeping encrypted archives (2f025cde22).
  • Wallet balances recover from RPC failures (#2459).
  • Bounties are reputation-backed with verified payouts (#2191, mobile #1575), and sponsors can fund creator support ads (#2185, mobile #1567).
  • Staking deposits can no longer be counted twice and every pool credit is backed by a verified receipt (backend #498, backend #499).
  • Paid audio is protected and keeps permanent access (backend #508).
  • The DEX shows only the DeHub pool (#2461), and a DHB listing-soon card takes email sign-ups (#2278).
  • Subscription allowances are versioned and checkout prices verified (#2245).

Transparency, feedback and requests

  • The stats page publishes revenue and costs (#2558), daily revenue totals (backend #516), recorded provider costs from April 2026 (#2705) and reconciled marketplace revenue (af0a169106).
  • Feedback is a dedicated page with all published feedback (#2640, mobile #2009).
  • Feedback is reachable from the navigation and the tools menu (cd644634a2).
  • Requests is a prompt-first workspace (#2717, mobile #2059).

Speed, reliability and the app

  • Web startup is bundled into about six files instead of hundreds (#2660), with less work on the first feed render (#2659).
  • An Intermission maintenance screen is served from the edge during outages (#2710, #2712), and the app has its own version (mobile be19296530).
  • The Android app moved to Expo 55 (mobile #1619), lifts its splash without waiting on the network (mobile #1632) and ships startup profiles (mobile ef329487ed).
  • Message boxes stay above the keyboard on every phone (mobile #2067).
  • Priority languages are complete across web and app (#2457, mobile #1826), with multilingual sitemaps and guide previews (#2485).
  • Guest visitors count in the online tracker (backend #519).

What's next

October is only half done. The rest of Q4 continues from here, and this page will keep growing with it.

## Wallets, payments and economy

- Wallet login and recovery use single-use proofs ([#2551](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2551), [backend #517](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-stream-backend/pull/517), [backend #518](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-stream-backend/pull/518)), and wallet encryption costs are bounded ([#2544](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2544)).
- Saved phone passkeys unlock on other browsers ([8363ec0509](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/commit/8363ec0509)), interrupted wallet resets resume ([#2681](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2681)), Import Wallet opens directly ([#2678](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2678)), and inaccessible wallets can be replaced while keeping encrypted archives ([2f025cde22](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/commit/2f025cde22)).
- Wallet balances recover from RPC failures ([#2459](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2459)).
- Bounties are reputation-backed with verified payouts ([#2191](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2191), [mobile #1575](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-mobile/pull/1575)), and sponsors can fund creator support ads ([#2185](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2185), [mobile #1567](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-mobile/pull/1567)).
- Staking deposits can no longer be counted twice and every pool credit is backed by a verified receipt ([backend #498](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-stream-backend/pull/498), [backend #499](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-stream-backend/pull/499)).
- Paid audio is protected and keeps permanent access ([backend #508](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehub-stream-backend/pull/508)).
- The DEX shows only the DeHub pool ([#2461](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2461)), and a DHB listing-soon card takes email sign-ups ([#2278](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2278)).
- Subscription allowances are versioned and checkout prices verified ([#2245](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2245)).

- Web startup is bundled into about six files instead of hundreds ([#2660](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2660)), with less work on the first feed render ([#2659](https://github.com/DeHubToken/dehubweb/pull/2659)).
